name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber PETG @base
filament_notes:
Covers Carbon Fiber PETG and Recycled Carbon Fiber PETG.
Proto-Pasta data: 250C@12 mm3/s, 80C plate. Hardened nozzle and gears required (abrasive). Use Magigoo or glue stick; purge thoroughly.
For the high-temperature HTPETG carbon-fiber lines see the dedicated Protopasta Carbon Fiber HTPETG profile.
